name: WP Adminify – White Label Dashboard, Admin Menu Editor, Login Customizer
author: Liton Arefin

sections.description:
Finally, a WordPress Dashboard You – and Your Clients – Will Actually Love. Customize, Brand, and Simplify..

Is your WordPress admin area a mess of menus your clients never use? Do you hesitate to hand over the keys because it looks… well, generic?

WP Adminify fixes that. It’s the complete WordPress client dashboard plugin that gives developers and agencies complete control to white-label the dashboard, hide complexity, and deliver a clean, professional, and branded experience that wows clients and simplifies their workflow.

➡️ See Live Demo | 📖 Read Docs | ⚡ Upgrade to Pro

🎬 Watch Overview Video:

Why Choose WP Adminify?

  • ✅ Client-Ready Dashboards: Impress clients with a fully branded admin panel. Remove “WordPress” logos, change menus, and add your own agency branding.
  • ✅ Unmatched Customization: Choose from beautiful pre-built UI templates, light/dark mode, custom colors, and fonts to create a dashboard that matches your WordPress Admin.
  • ✅ Simplify Client Onboarding: Hide complex menu items they don’t need with the powerful Admin Menu Editor. Prevent support calls and confusion.
  • ✅ Boost Your Productivity: Organize media with folders, replace images without breaking links, remove annoying admin notices, and add custom widgets.
  • ✅ Enhance Security: Change your login URL, disable comments site-wide, and control user access with smart redirects.

Who Is It For?

  • WordPress Agencies: Deliver a white-labeled, professional WordPress Dashboard to your clients.
  • Freelance Developers: Create streamlined, simple admin dashboards for your clients.
  • E-commerce Store Managers: Simplify the complex WooCommerce menu and the Dashboard UI for daily operations.
  • Power Users & Bloggers: Take back control of your Dashboard and remove all the clutter.

Key Features

WP Adminify packs over 60+ powerful features into one plugin. Here are the highlights:

🎨 Dashboard & Login Customization

  • White Label WordPress: Rebrand the entire admin area. Change logos, footer text, menu labels, and more.
  • Modern UI Templates: Apply stunning pre-designed skins (Light, Dark, Glass, etc.) with one click. You can use Custom CSS to design your WordPress Dashboard, too.
  • Login Customizer: Design a custom login page that matches your brand using loginfy.
  • Light/Dark Mode: Automatic or manual switching with independent logos for each mode.
  • Custom CSS/JS: Add your own code to the admin area without touching theme files.

🧩 Admin Menu Editor

  • Drag & Drop Editor: Visually rearrange, rename, add, or hide any admin menu item or submenu.
  • Role-Based Visibility: Show or hide specific menu items for different user roles (e.g., hide “Themes” from clients).
  • Custom Admin Pages: Create new pages inside the dashboard using Elementor, Gutenberg, or other builders.
  • User Info Panel: Show or hide the user profile area in the menu.

⚡ Productivity Boosters

  • Media Library Folders: Finally organize your media files with a simple drag-and-drop folder system.
  • 👉 Media Replace (UPCOMMING!): Replace any image or file directly from the media library without changing its URL. Essential for SEO and fixing broken links. Learn More
  • Admin Notices Manager: Disable all those annoying update and promo notices for a clean, focused workspace.
  • Duplicate Posts & Menus: Clone any post, page, or menu in seconds.
  • Custom Dashboard Widgets: Add new widgets (e.g., RSS feed, custom content) to the dashboard.

🔒 Security & Performance

  • Login & Admin Redirects: Change the login URL (/wp-admin) and set custom redirects after login/logout based on user role.
  • Disable Comments: Globally turn off comments to prevent spam and hide comment fields everywhere.
  • Disable Embeds & Heartbeat API: Reduce server load and improve backend performance.
  • Clean Up Head Section: Remove unnecessary code like RSS feeds, emojis, and version numbers.

🔌 Powerful Addons

Extend functionality with dedicated modules:

  • Custom WordPress login page: Create a custom branded WordPress login page with Loginfy Addon.
  • Admin Columns Editor: Customize list views for posts, pages, and custom post types.
  • Activity Logs: Track every user action on your site.
  • Google PageSpeed Insights: Check site speed directly from your dashboard.
  • RoleMaster Suite: Fine-tune user roles and capabilities.
  • …and many more!

🚀 Get WP Adminify Pro – Unlock All Features & Addons
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New within your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “WP Adminify”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. A new menu item “WP Adminify” will appear. Click on it to start customizing!
  5. (Optional) For even more power, upgrade to Pro to unlock all addons and features.
sections.faq:
Can I use the white label features for free?

Yes! The free version includes robust white-labeling options. The Pro version unlocks even more advanced branding controls.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. WP Adminify is built for performance. It only loads its scripts on the WordPress admin area, leaving your front-end site speed completely unaffected.

Is it compatible with my theme and other plugins?

Absolutely. But if you are using a third-party plugin that hasn’t developed their theme or plugin with the standard WordPress development guidelines, then you may face some issues with the theme and plugin.

Do I need coding skills to use it?

Not at all. WP Adminify provides an intuitive, point-and-click interface. No code required!

How do I get support?

Our dedicated support team is ready to help. Pro users get priority support. Contact us here.
